lib='''"""Reusable grid helpers for ARC-style tasks (backgrounds, runs/bars, markers, line drawing)."""

from collections import Counter


def find_background(grid):
    """Return the most common cell value (assumed background)."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]


def find_bars(grid, bg, min_len=2):
    """Return maximal horizontal runs (row, c0, c1, value) of length >= min_len of non-bg cells."""
    bars = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        j = 0
        w = len(row)
        while j < w:
            k = j
            while k < w and row[k] == row[j]:
                k += 1
            if row[j] != bg and k - j >= min_len:
                bars.append((i, j, k - 1, row[j]))
            j = k
    return bars


def find_markers(grid, bg):
    """Return non-bg single cells (row, col, value) not part of any bar-like run >= 2."""
    bars = find_bars(grid, bg)
    out = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        for j, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg and not any(i == b[0] and b[1] <= j <= b[2] for b in bars):
                out.append((i, j, v))
    return out


def draw_vertical_line(grid, col, value, bg=None, rows=None):
    """Draw a vertical line of value at col (over bg cells only if bg given); rows selects row span (default all)."""
    h = len(grid)
    if rows is None:
        rows = range(h)
    for i in rows:
        if 0 <= i < h and (bg is None or grid[i][col] == bg):
            grid[i][col] = value
    return grid


def copy_grid(grid):
    """Deep-copy a grid."""
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''

    bars = find_bars(grid, bg)
    marks = find_markers(grid, bg)
